They do not list the election cycle or the elections of other years. A four-year odd-year cycle would be an inference from the pattern of found results, so this year is left unresolved. The Marion County Election Board results document records a mayoral contest for the Indianapolis general (municipal) election on 2011-11-08. Winner and runner-up are in indianapolis_results.json.

The Indiana Election Division 2022 calendar (December 2021 to March 2023) lists the offices on the 2022 ballot. City offices such as mayor are not among them. The next municipal election day in that calendar is November 7, 2023, so no mayoral election fell in 2022.

The Marion County Election Board results document records a mayoral contest for the Indianapolis general (municipal) election on 2023-11-07. The Indiana Election Division 2023 calendar lists November 7, 2023 as municipal election day and city offices such as mayor as offices on the ballot (its heading says 2022, which is an apparent typo). Winner and runner-up are in indianapolis_results.json.

The Indiana Election Division 2024 calendar (December 2023 to March 2025) lists the offices on the 2024 ballot. City offices such as mayor are not among them. It lists November 7, 2023 as the municipal election date in the 2023 calendar and notes that the term of a mayor elected in 2023 begins January 1, 2024. No municipal election is listed for 2024, so no mayoral election fell in 2024. The earlier note that the 2023 calendar shows a 2027 date and a four-year term was wrong and is removed.

The Indiana Election Division 2024 calendar (December 2023 to March 2025) states that only the towns of Montezuma, Cambridge City and Vernon may hold elections in 2025. Indianapolis is a city, so it is not included. The 2026 calendar (November 2025 to November 2027) lists the next municipal election day as November 2, 2027. No mayoral election fell in 2025. The 2024 calendar does not cover April to October 2025, so that part rests on the statement that only those towns may hold 2025 elections.

The Indiana Election Division 2026 calendar lists the offices on the 2026 ballot. City offices such as mayor are not among them. The calendar lists November 2, 2027 as municipal election day, with candidate forms for a city or town office in 2027. No mayoral election falls in 2026.
